sources.entry: clickhouse-connect - The official ClickHouse client, with SQLAlchemy and Superset connectors.

summary.one_liner: ClickHouse Connect is the official Python driver for ClickHouse, offering DataFrame, Arrow, and NumPy output plus SQLAlchemy and Apache Superset connectivity.
summary.what_it_does: The driver connects Python to ClickHouse over its HTTP interface and returns results as Pandas DataFrames (numpy- and arrow-backed), NumPy arrays, PyArrow tables, or Polars DataFrames. It includes a Superset connector and a lightweight SQLAlchemy dialect supporting Core selects, joins, FINAL, SAMPLE, lightweight deletes, and Alembic migrations. An async client based on aiohttp is available as an optional extra. An experimental chDB backend runs queries against an embedded in-process engine. It works with both ClickHouse Cloud and self-hosted servers.
use_cases: load ClickHouse query results into pandas DataFrames
run SQLAlchemy Core queries against ClickHouse
manage ClickHouse schema migrations with Alembic
async ClickHouse queries in Python with aiohttp
run ClickHouse queries embedded in-process with chDB
how_to_run: pip install clickhouse-connect[chdb] (experimental embedded chDB backend)
notable: Official ClickHouse Python client, with Superset and SQLAlchemy dialect support
Returns results as pandas, NumPy, PyArrow, or Polars objects
Async SQLAlchemy dialect and Alembic migration support
Optional Rust-based clickhouse-connect-core binding versioned separately
caveats: Full SQLAlchemy ORM is not supported; UPDATE compilation, relationship reflection, and RETURNING are not implemented
Async SQLAlchemy results are buffered and server-side cursors are not supported
Upgrading from 0.x requires following the breaking-change guide in MIGRATION.md
